title: DOPE: Decoy Oriented Perturbation Encapsulation Human-Readable, AI-Hostile Documents for Academic Integrity

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing detection rates between native and non-native English speakers on long-form assessment answers to evaluate whether the system disproportionately over-flags non-native writers.
Comparing detection rates across STEM and humanities domains to ensure there are no statistically significant differences in performance based on the subject area.
